paragraphs: Description This coding challenge consists of developing a client application for Discogs. Discogs is the biggest database of information about audio recordings in all formats (cassette, vinyl, CDs, etc.) Discogs’ RESTful open API allows developers to access JSON-formatted information about Database objects such as Artists, Releases, and Labels.
